name: OpenImmersive Translator
tagline: Read any web page side by side with its translation. Open-source extension for Chrome, Firefox and Edge.
description:
OpenImmersive Translator (openimmersive.ai) is a browser extension and a website for reading in two languages.

The extension is open source under AGPL-3.0 and runs on Chrome, Firefox and Edge. It shows each paragraph of a web page followed by its translation, so you keep the original in view. Google, Microsoft and MyMemory engines are free and need no account. With your own DeepL, OpenAI or DeepSeek key, requests go from the browser straight to that provider.

The website translates files too. Text-based PDFs up to 200 pages and 50 MB keep their layout, with 3 pages free a day and no subscription needed for longer files. Word, PowerPoint, Excel, TXT, Markdown and SRT files come back in the same format, and the Fast tier is free with no account for files up to 10 MB. Images are read with OCR and translated, and manga pages get the translation written back into each speech bubble, 3 pages a day free.

Limits: no Safari or mobile app, no live video subtitles, no flashcards, and scanned PDFs are not supported.
